items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: I remember once when Helen Humes sang in our house she was knocked over by Helen Humes’ singing.

ctx.x: What did your wife and daughter think of this passion of yours?

I think my wife was very supportive. I think she enjoyed meeting all these people. My daughter liked it, it wasn’t her kind of music but I remember once when Helen Humes sang in our house she was knocked over by Helen Humes’ singing. And she liked Laurel Watson, because Lisa wanted to sing and Laurel gave her some pointers. And so she kind of, I think they liked, or they respected what I was doing. And they enjoyed it. They enjoyed it I think.
Well it must be rewarding and then difficult at the same time.
